g.text: Roadster Flight Lab 3.12 | Braking during a turn

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536576

g.text: Matched rolling initialization at 90 km/h, then 1 s at 2% throttle; the measured 4 s use steer = +1, brake = 15%, throttle = 0.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536576

g.text: Existing speed/surface steering maps remain active: wheel angles vary with speed. Both versions request 6.300 kN total braking.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24374a
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24374a
font-size: 9.45px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536576

g.text: Statistics above the panels use every 120 Hz solver step over 4 s. Peak |β| includes only actual speed ≥ 30 km/h; the signed β curves retain lower speeds.

text.style: font-size: 9.45px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536576

g.text: Friction utilization is the maximum of the four recorded combined-force ratios. The > 0.99 duration counts any wheel above that threshold, without a speed filter.

text.style: font-size: 9.45px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536576

g.text: Lines join the 80 saved samples at 20 Hz, t = 0.00833–3.95833 s; they are not extrapolated to 4 s. Path origins are the first saved positions, with no rotation or scale fitting.

text.style: font-size: 9.45px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536576

g.text: This is the full mapped-steering / 15% braking fault case. Gentle 20% steering was already stable. Both pairs retain four tire contacts and zero rigid contacts throughout.

text.style: font-size: 9.45px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536576

g.text: Flat-world numerical evidence only: no keyboard latency, camera feel, city-route, WebGL image or GPU/FPS acceptance. Source: qa/braking-controls-curves-3.12.json
